tagline: Financial reconciliation and exception resolution with deterministic controls; the agent investigates and proposes, humans approve auditable actions.
verifiedBy: build-time GitHub ingestion (allowlisted paths only) + curated overlay

decisions.title: ADR-001: Hybrid AI Architecture — Deterministic + LLM
decisions.summary: Deterministic finance engines own all math (Decimal-only); LLM agents are read-only renderers behind a typed assertion pipeline.
decisions.limits: Describes the intended layering; per-module compliance (e.g. finance/ LLM-free) must be confirmed in code before claiming enforcement.

decisions.title: ADR-007: No LLM Calculations — Deterministic Code Owns All Math
decisions.summary: The LLM never performs arithmetic of any kind; every figure originates from deterministic engines and is cross-checked post-render.
decisions.limits: Text verified in source; CI arithmetic-gate behavior and prompt-template compliance need workflow run evidence.

decisions.title: ADR-009: Seven-Stage Validation Harness — No Stage Skip
decisions.summary: Seven validation stages with no-skip enforcement and defined hard/soft failure modes ending in an executive-summary circuit breaker.
decisions.limits: Harness design verified in source; per-stage pass evidence needs dated integration/evaluation runs.

decisions.title: ADR-015: AI Trust Boundary — Verified Assertions In, Language Out; Audit Before AI
decisions.summary: Hard trust boundary (verified assertions in, language out), RAG disabled by default, audit-before-AI ordering for production promotion.
decisions.limits: RAG-disabled and audit-before-AI are stated policy; tenant-config and audit-chain evidence needed to claim deployment compliance.

decisions.title: Decision Log
decisions.summary: Decision log covering Sheets scope, Pydantic validation, structured outputs, context packs, evidence-backed claims, and trust boundary.
decisions.limits: Summary mirror of the ADR rationale; canonical detail lives in the individual ADRs linked above.

evidence.limits: Live-model evaluation is unqualified until a controlled manual eval is executed and its results recorded with dates.
evidence.scope: Controlled LLM eval gate; explicitly performs no provider calls in CI

evidence.env: CI ubuntu-latest (config verified; individual run links not yet recorded)
evidence.limits: Proves the gates exist and what they cover; does not by itself prove any single run passed — link dated runs before claiming passes.
evidence.scope: ruff, ruff format, secret-leak rg gate, mypy baseline ratchet, pytest tests/unit + tests/contract

limitations: Live-model evaluation is In progress (manual gate, never CI) — do not present FinSight as model-qualified.
